facts.defaultAndPrecedence: Uses `true`. A non-empty process value wins; otherwise the deploy script uses `true`.
facts.reloadOrRetention: Disabling the switch skips LITELLM installation; dependent features can remain unavailable.

facts.defaultAndPrecedence: Uses `true`. A non-empty process value wins; otherwise the deploy script uses `true`.
facts.reloadOrRetention: Disabling the switch skips POSTGRESQL installation; dependent features can remain unavailable.
facts.sensitivity: ordinary-value

facts.defaultAndPrecedence: `auto`: use prompts only when `/dev/tty` is readable and writable. A non-empty process value wins; otherwise `auto` applies.
facts.reloadOrRetention: Noninteractive mode requires existing target Secrets, SOPS, source-namespace copies, or bootstrap inputs.
facts.sensitivity: secret-setup-control

facts.defaultAndPrecedence: Uses `false` and reuses existing Secrets. A non-empty process value wins; otherwise existing target Secrets remain authoritative.
facts.reloadOrRetention: When enabled, later configured sources can replace live credential material and trigger dependent restarts or auth failures.
facts.sensitivity: secret-setup-control

facts.defaultAndPrecedence: Startup uses kubeclaw for an unset or empty process value. Deploy setup, secrets, and all through setup can subsequently select a valid saved namespace when the variable was unset, or an accepted interactive response. For commands without workspace resolution, the nonempty process value wins over the kubeclaw startup fallback. Deploy setup, secrets, and all through setup additionally load a valid saved file only when NAMESPACE was unset; false or auto with a set variable retains the chosen value, while true with a terminal accepts a replacement even for an explicit process value. Any accepted prompt response wins and is persisted/exported.
facts.reloadOrRetention: Changing it redirects namespaced reads, writes, release ownership, Secret setup, and policy operations.
facts.sensitivity: ordinary-value

facts.defaultAndPrecedence: Uses `$HOME/openclaw-swarm/ansible/group_vars/production/secrets.yml`. Existing target Secret data wins unless overwrite is enabled; then the configured SOPS file is considered before source-namespace copy and interactive input.
facts.reloadOrRetention: Changing it changes the encrypted authority from which missing credential values can be loaded.
facts.sensitivity: ordinary-value

facts.defaultAndPrecedence: Uses `default`. Existing target Secrets win unless overwrite is enabled; SOPS is checked before source-namespace copy.
facts.reloadOrRetention: Changing it changes only the copy source; target Secrets are still written to `NAMESPACE`.
